owner.en: Merge this status record. Decide: G power-loss posture; whether the unplanned 2026-11-03 reboot counts for R1 / PLN-04; a Tier-3 destination class, auditd install, alert channel and dead-man. A1: stage the Windows public key for SSH over Tailscale. Do not use the desktop Software Updater's Install Now: it bypasses decision H.
